title: AI coding agents
lead: Skein UI is built so that AI coding agents write correct code with it: every component is described in data, and the CLI gives the agent a way to look things up and check its work.

why.title: Why it works well with agents
why.p1: Agents guess. With most libraries a guess is a `className` that half works, or a prop that doesn't exist. In Skein the looks are not in the code at all, props are data with a fixed set of allowed values, and the same names (`value` / `onValueChange`, `open` / `onOpenChange`) are used everywhere, so there is much less to get wrong.
why.p2: `@skeinui/ui` ships `manifest.json`: every component's props, allowed values, parts, data types and examples. The CLI, the MCP server and the docs site's `llms.txt` all read it, so an agent sees exactly what this documentation shows.

project.title: What a project carries
project.p1: Projects made by `skein create` come with instructions for agents, rendered for the features you picked:
project.agents: The rules of the project: layout, conventions, commands. Read by Codex, Cursor and most agents.
project.skillUi: Using the components: look up before writing, data props, no `className`.
project.skillPage: Adding a page: `skein new page`, the files of a page, translations, mocks.
project.skillTheme: Changing the look: theme styles, overrides, writing a theme style.

loop.title: The feedback loop
loop.p1: The instructions point agents at three commands:
loop.p2: With `--json` the output is meant for the agent: each problem with its file, line and a hint for the fix. An agent that runs `skein check` and `skein preview` before saying it is done catches its own mistakes.

mcp.title: MCP server
mcp.p1: `skein mcp` serves the CLI as MCP tools (`skein_docs`, `skein_check`, `skein_preview`, `skein_new_page`, `skein_theme_init`, …) over stdio. It is opt-in: create the project with `--mcp` (and `--preview` for the browser check):
mcp.p2: That writes `.mcp.json`, which Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP clients pick up:

llms.title: llms.txt
llms.p1: This site publishes [/llms.txt](/llms.txt), an index of the docs, and [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt), every component's props and examples in one Markdown file. Give either to an agent that works outside a Skein project.
